baseline_policy: The primary baseline and frozen intent-to-treat membership are immutable. Corrections are append-only exact site-mention resolution transitions and produce a separately hashed sensitivity run.
source_realizability_invariants: resolved mentions have exactly one target
ambiguous mentions have at least two distinct targets
unique direct targets never exceed resolved mention count

sensitivity_estimands.fixed_frozen_intent_to_treat: Recompute corrected evidence and outcomes while retaining every original ITT artifact, opportunity binding, pair-side membership, and denominator.
sensitivity_estimands.corrected_source_counterfactual_reselect: Separately rerun result-blind queue selection from corrected source primitives and report exact private additions/removals plus aggregate denominator changes. This is not the frozen ITT estimand.

chain_trust.configuration_rule: A separately reviewed release-contract change must pin an exact canonical registration artifact by prior Git commit/path/SHA-256/blob. That artifact binds the genuine genesis, prior ledger head, and both private baseline hashes; release policy activation must strictly postdate registration and predate every review decision. After the first correction, each registration binds the exact prior ledger commit, SHA-256, Git blob OID, sequence, and record hash before any extension can run.
chain_trust.current_effect: No production correction sensitivity can run until genuine chain roots and production reviewer identities are registered; the preregistered primary analysis currently applies zero corrections.

sensitivity_publication: Only non-bulk aggregate metrics and cryptographic ledger hashes may be released; corrected mention, record, exact membership, and exact counterfactual change ledgers remain private.
